ns2:section.sectionText: Undergraduate student enrollment section. Meets with LIS 490 STG. Meets in Room 341 LIS Bldg, 501 E. Daniel St., C. See course syllabus (http://courseweb.lis.illinois.edu/~mwolske/lis490st/summer14/syllabusSummer14-LIS490ST.pdf) for details regarding specific studio project for Summer 2014 offering. Instructor permission required to enroll (mwolske@illinois.edu / jongant@illinois.edu), but expectation is prior experience with field of Community Informatics and/or Journalism demonstrated by successful completion of one of the following courses: LIS/INFO/MACS 202; LIS 418; LIS 451A4 or AL6; LIS 518; JOUR 415. Juniors, seniors. 4 UG hours.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
